# pinchos

> pinchos runs the commands you give it and pins their output to the macOS menu bar.

pinchos is a macOS menu bar utility. It runs the commands you give it and keeps their output close at hand. Use one plain-text item and an ordered submenu of values, cached reads, and actions.

The 0.1 product is deliberately small: one command-backed item and an ordered native submenu of static values, cached values, actions, and separators.

It is free, open source, and native AppKit. There is no Electron and no settings window.

Pinchos targets Apple Silicon (arm64) Macs on macOS 14+.

## Install

Until v0.1.0 is published, the curl installer and Homebrew cask fail closed on a missing artifact or checksum. Clone and build with the Swift toolchain:

```
git clone https://github.com/douglasjarquin/pinchos.git
cd pinchos
swift build -c release
.build/release/pinchos config-path
.build/release/pinchos init
.build/release/pinchos validate
.build/release/pinchos
```

The release executable is `.build/release/pinchos`. With no arguments it launches the menu-bar app in the foreground and keeps the terminal busy until the app quits, so it has not hung; any argument goes to the CLI. Stop it with Quit Pinchos from its menu (Quit in the recovery menu), or Ctrl-C in the launching terminal. The README covers first run, the canonical config format, and the menu-row contract:

https://github.com/douglasjarquin/pinchos
